---
AllCops:
  TargetRubyVersion: 2.7
Gemspec/DevelopmentDependencies:
  Description: Checks that development dependencies are specified in Gemfile rather
    than gemspec.
  Enabled: true
  VersionAdded: '1.44'
  EnforcedStyle: Gemfile
  SupportedStyles:
  - Gemfile
  - gems.rb
  - gemspec
  AllowedGems:
  - allowed
  Include:
  - "**/*.gemspec"
  - "**/Gemfile"
  - "**/gems.rb"
  AutoCorrect: always
